resources.string: Warns you the moment a scam message or link is on your screen.

Sniff reads the text that is visible on your screen and in new notifications so it can warn you about scam messages and links (fake KYC, bank, parcel, electricity bill, prize and UPI collect scams). It skips password fields, keyboards and banking/UPI apps. Each new message or link is checked by Sniff AI; the text is not stored on a server. Warnings are kept only on your phone, in Sniff\'s History, which you can clear. If a browser opens a dangerous site, Sniff can close it and take you somewhere safe.

Sniff reads the text on your screen and in new notifications using Android\'s Accessibility setting. It never reads password fields or keyboards and ignores banking and UPI apps. Each new message or link is checked by Sniff AI and is never stored on a server. Warnings are saved only on this phone in History, and you can clear them any time.

What Sniff reads: the text on your screen and in new notifications, using Android's Accessibility setting, only to spot scam messages and phishing links. It skips password fields, keyboards and banking/UPI apps.

What Sniff does: shows you a warning, and can close a dangerous website by pressing Back.

What is sent: only the text or link of a suspicious message, to Sniff's own checker. Nothing is sold or shared. Your history stays on this phone.

Privacy policy: sniff-orpin.vercel.app
